Is it running?</b><br>systemctl status app<br>ps -ef | grep java<br>ss -tlnp | grep 8080" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a1a1a;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="60" width="210" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="v-res" value="<b>2. Resources?</b><br>uptime (load)<br>top / free -h<br>df -h ; df -i" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=1.5;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a1a1a;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="260" y="60" width="210" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="v-logs" value="<b>3. Logs?</b><br>tail -f catalina.out<br>grep -i error app.log<br>journalctl -u app" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1.5;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a1a1a;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="500" y="60" width="210" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="v-net" value="<b>4. Dependencies?</b><br>curl -v localhost:8080<br>nc -zv db 1521<br>nslookup db-host" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=1.5;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a1a1a;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="740" y="60" width="210" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="v-fix" value="<b>5. Mitigate</b><br>restart / free disk<br>roll back<br>then RCA" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a1a1a;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="980" y="60" width="180" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="v-tip" value="<b>Say it out loud while you work</b><br>"First I check scope: one user or all, one server or all, since when, any change or deployment in that window?<br>Then: is the process up and listening, are CPU / memory / disk / inodes healthy, what do the logs say at that time,<br>can the app reach its database and downstream services? I restore service first, keep evidence (logs, thread dump),<br>and open a problem ticket for the RCA."" style="rounded=1;absoluteArcSize=1;arcSize=16;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=1.5;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a1a1a;fontFamily=Helvetica;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=6;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="210" width="1140" height="140" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="e0" value="" style="html=1;rounded=0;endArrow=classic;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1a1a1a;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;startArrow=none;" edge="1" parent="1" source="v-up" target="v-res"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="e1" value="" style="html=1;rounded=0;endArrow=classic;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1a1a1a;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;startArrow=none;" edge="1" parent="1" source="v-res" target="v-logs"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="e2" value="" style="html=1;rounded=0;endArrow=classic;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1a1a1a;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;startArrow=none;" edge="1" parent="1" source="v-logs" target="v-net"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="e3" value="" style="html=1;rounded=0;endArrow=classic;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1a1a1a;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;startArrow=none;" edge="1" parent="1" source="v-net" target="v-fix"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

text.tspan: "The application is slow / down": Linux triage order
Say it out loud while you work
"First I check scope: one user or all, one server or all, since when, any change or deployment in that window?
Then: is the process up and listening, are CPU / memory / disk / inodes healthy, what do the logs say at that time,
can the app reach its database and downstream services? I restore service first, keep evidence (logs, thread dump),
and open a problem ticket for the RCA."
